title: List the top league with the highest total goals scored in the 2015/2016 se
question: List the top league with the highest total goals scored in the 2015/2016 season among leagues whose teams include at least one with a 'Fast' build-up play speed class.

prediction.sql:
SELECT L."XCL_005"
FROM League AS L
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND L."XCL_003" IN (
    SELECT M2."XCL_008"
    FROM Match AS M2
    INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON TA."XCL_177" IN (M2."XCL_013", M2."XCL_014")
    WHERE TA."XCL_180" = 'Fast'
  )
GROUP BY L."XCL_003", L."XCL_005"
ORDER BY SUM(M."XCL_015" + M."XCL_016") DESC
LIMIT 1
